npcs.name: Lord Edric Vale
npcs.description: Edric holds down an upper-district receiving hall with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable noble patron are often sent to Edric, who claims an upper-district receiving hall as familiar ground. At 48, this Human has learned to watch hands before faces. He offers wine before answers; neighbors joke that he would miss a festival before misplacing the signet he twists when lying politely. Married to Mirelle; affair with Lysa; patron to Mayor. He is saving courage and coin alike to place Perrin in a marriage that secures docking privileges, while trying not to let scandal costing him local officials influence decide the ending. Misplaced a spare signet the same week Mira found one in a cloak hem.
npcs.personality: Warm with regulars, curt with wasters; offers wine before answers.
npcs.motivation: Secure enough ground to place Perrin in a marriage that secures docking privileges.
npcs.secret: Quietly arranging matters around this problem: Misplaced a spare signet the same week Mira found one in a cloak hem.
npcs.rumor: Customers claim Edric knows which doors open after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Polite public voice; sharper private asides when trust appears.
npcs.appearance: Looks like someone who sleeps lightly; distinctive detail is the signet he twists when lying politely.

relationships.note: Meet in the old orangery after salon hours.

npcs.name: Lady Mirelle Vale
npcs.description: Local estate hostess whose days orbit a noble estate's guest rooms and small lasting loyalties.
npcs.biography: Before dawn, Mirelle is already at a noble estate's guest rooms, working as a estate hostess with yesterday's work still on her fingers. The habit everyone notices is simple: she rearranges flowers when displeased. Close by sits her prized the invitation ledger with coded dots, a small anchor in a loud settlement. Edric's spouse; confides in Cressida. She wants to host the prince's envoy next season. She fears becoming a punchline in Cressida's circle more than open confrontation. A useful adventure hook trails her: Hired a private listener to watch the orangery path at night.
npcs.personality: Dry humor over a careful heart; rearranges flowers when displeased.
npcs.motivation: Finish one honest plan: host the prince's envoy next season.

npcs.rumor: Customers claim Mirelle knows which doors open after hours—if asked the right way.

npcs.appearance: Human features shaped by work at a noble estate's guest rooms; watch for the invitation ledger with coded dots.

npcs.name: Sir Halden Rook
npcs.description: Halden holds down a noble household's side hall with callused competence and open ears.
npcs.biography: Halden did not plan to become the neighborhood's go-to knight retainer, yet a noble household's side hall made the choice stick. Now 37, the Human measures success in quiet evenings and unpaid favors returned. He checks his reflection in his blade, and keeps the favor ribbon he pretends is from a lady of standing the way a confessor keeps secrets. Retainer to the Vales; uneasy. Hope pulls one way—earn land of his own through honest service—while caution pulls the other because of being ordered to cover Edric's sins. Saw Edric and Lysa in the orangery and chose silence—for now.
npcs.personality: Warm with regulars, curt with wasters; checks his reflection in his blade.
npcs.motivation: Secure enough ground to earn land of his own through honest service.

npcs.appearance: Looks like someone who sleeps lightly; distinctive detail is the favor ribbon he pretends is from a lady of standing.

npcs.name: Cressida Fenn
npcs.description: Local court gossip whose days orbit fashionable parlors and small lasting loyalties.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable court gossip are often sent to Cressida, who claims fashionable parlors as familiar ground. At 33, this Half-Elf has learned to watch hands before faces. She laughs softly at secrets she already knew; neighbors joke that she would miss a festival before misplacing the fan with a hollow rivet for notes. Confidante to Mirelle; plays both sides. She is saving courage and coin alike to become the town's indispensable matchmaker of alliances, while trying not to let backing the wrong Vale in a house split decide the ending. Sold a rumor about Lysa to Kitty Shade for theater tickets and leverage.
npcs.personality: Dry humor over a careful heart; laughs softly at secrets she already knew.
npcs.motivation: Finish one honest plan: become the town's indispensable matchmaker of alliances.
npcs.secret: Keeps proof related to a problem—Sold a rumor about Lysa to Kitty Shade for theater tickets and leverage.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near fashionable parlors on a night Cressida worked late.
npcs.voice: Storyteller rhythm even when discussing ledgers or latches.
npcs.appearance: Half-Elf features shaped by work at fashionable parlors; watch for the fan with a hollow rivet for notes.

npcs.name: Baron Torvald Ash
npcs.description: The mining magnate people recommend when they actually want the job finished.
npcs.biography: Baron Torvald Ash works from a counting room above the market with the stubborn patience of a 140-year-old Dwarf who has already survived harder seasons. He weighs coins on a pocket scale mid-conversation, and keeps the nugget pendant from his first profitable shaft close when tempers rise. Business rival/partner talks with Edric. His private aim is simple: buy river docking rights from Edric. Still, he flinches at the thought of sabotage in the mines blamed on 'adventurers'. Lately a fresh problem has landed in his lap: Suspects Orrin's 'spice losses' are cover for ore theft.
npcs.personality: Soft-spoken until principles are poked; weighs coins on a pocket scale mid-conversation.
npcs.motivation: Turn today's scrapes into tomorrow's chance to buy river docking rights from Edric.
npcs.secret: Night thoughts keep returning to sabotage in the mines blamed on 'adventurers', especially since: Suspects Orrin's 'spice losses' are cover for ore theft.
npcs.rumor: A smugglers' mark was seen near a counting room above the market on a night Baron worked late.
npcs.voice: Quick local diction, then sudden silences that mean more than words.
npcs.appearance: Easy to spot near a counting room above the market: dwarf, practical layers, and the nugget pendant from his first profitable shaft.

npcs.name: Lysa Thorne
npcs.description: A lady-in-waiting rooted at side corridors of a noble house, known for how she checks over her shoulder before she smiles.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable lady-in-waiting are often sent to Lysa, who claims side corridors of a noble house as familiar ground. At 28, this Human has learned to watch hands before faces. She checks over her shoulder before she smiles; neighbors joke that she would miss a festival before misplacing the locket with a blank painted face. Affair with Edric; client of Hedda. She is saving courage and coin alike to leave town with enough coin to vanish kindly, while trying not to let Mirelle's private listener decide the ending. Tried to pawn Edric's gift ring; Lina almost recognized the crest.
npcs.personality: Steady and sharp-eyed; checks over her shoulder before she smiles.
npcs.motivation: To leave town with enough coin to vanish kindly, even while fearing Mirelle's private listener.
npcs.secret: Knows more about this than she admits: Tried to pawn Edric's gift ring; Lina almost recognized the crest.
npcs.rumor: Locals whisper that the locket with a blank painted face once belonged to a traveler who vanished on the road.
npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A human silhouette framed by side corridors of a noble house, hands seldom empty of the locket with a blank painted face.

relationships.note: Meet in the old orangery after salon hours.

npcs.name: Perrin Vale
npcs.description: Familiar face at tutoring rooms and estate gardens; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable heir apparent are often sent to Perrin, who claims tutoring rooms and estate gardens as familiar ground. At 17, this Human has learned to watch hands before faces. He challenges anyone who calls him 'boy'; neighbors joke that he would miss a festival before misplacing the practice rapier with a noble wire wrap. Heir; trained illicitly by Hobb's yard. He is saving courage and coin alike to win a real duel that makes minstrels sing, while trying not to let being married off before he sees the world decide the ending. Paid Cal for introductions to 'dangerous friends'.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; challenges anyone who calls him 'boy'.
npcs.motivation: Protect his livelihood long enough to win a real duel that makes minstrels sing.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies the truth: Paid Cal for introductions to 'dangerous friends'.
npcs.rumor: Locals whisper that the practice rapier with a noble wire wrap once belonged to a traveler who vanished on the road.
npcs.voice: Measured human cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn human garb; the practice rapier with a noble wire wrap always nearby.

npcs.name: Dame Orla Quince
npcs.description: Local salon patron whose days orbit an evening salon and small lasting loyalties.
npcs.biography: Before dawn, Orla is already at an evening salon, working as a salon patron with yesterday's work still on her fingers. The habit everyone notices is simple: she corrects pronunciation of dead poets. Close by sits her prized the portrait collection with one face turned to the wall, a small anchor in a loud settlement. Patron of arts; employs Cressida's gossip. She wants to fund a public theater that outlives gossip. She fears mortality fashion among humans rushing her into patronage mistakes more than open confrontation. A useful adventure hook trails her: Commissioned Nessa to sing a satire soft enough to sting Edric.

npcs.motivation: Finish one honest plan: fund a public theater that outlives gossip.

npcs.rumor: Someone paid Orla to forget a name connected to recent trouble near an evening salon.
